body.name: Representative-neutrality predicate
body.construction: For \(C\subseteq H\), set \(S_C:=\{s_h:h\in C\}\) and \(T_C(c):=V_\ell\setminus(S_C\cup\{c\})\). When both measured endpoint pairs belong to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\), set \(N_c(C):=\mathbf 1\{\rho_\ell(S_C,T_C(c))=\rho_\ell(S_C\cup\{c\},T_C(c))\}\).
